q1.sampleAnswer: His office is near Century Avenue.

keyPoints.descZh: 办公室在世纪大道附近

q1.explanationZh: Tom 说他的办公室靠近 Century Avenue（世纪大道），直接用这句话回答。

evidence.quote: My office is near Century Avenue.

q2.sampleAnswer: The flat has one bedroom, one kitchen and one bathroom.

keyPoints.descZh: 有一间卧室、一间厨房和一间浴室
examples: one bedroom, one kitchen and one bathroom

q2.rubricZh: 要点：一间卧室、一间厨房、一间浴室。
q2.explanationZh: 中介介绍附近那套房子时说了它的房间构成：一卧、一厨、一卫。

evidence.quote: It has one bedroom, one kitchen and one bathroom.

q3.sampleAnswer: Tom will have to pay 3,500 yuan.
q3.rubricZh: 要点：3,500元（3000基础保证金+500宠物保证金）。
q3.explanationZh: 基础保证金是 3,000 元，养宠物要额外再交 500 元，合起来是 3,500 元。

evidence.quote: Small pets are allowed, but there will be an extra security deposit of 500 yuan.

keyPoints.descZh: 否定回答：中介没有给折扣

q4.rubricZh: 要点：否定回答 No, it doesn’t.
q4.explanationZh: Tom 问能不能打折，中介说要问房东，所以并没有给折扣，反意疑问句用 No 回答。

evidence.quote: I’m not sure. I will ask the landlord.

q5.explanationZh: Tom 想明天早上去看房，中介问十点可以吗，Tom 说好，所以是明天十点。

q6.sampleAnswer: I expect the flat to have a large sitting room, a comfortable bedroom, a nice kitchen, a clean bathroom and a small study. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 说出对房子的合理期望
examples: a large sitting room and a comfortable bedroom

q6.rubricZh: 开放题，合理即可：说出期望房子具备的设施或房间。
q6.explanationZh: 这是开放题，没有唯一答案。写出你希望房子有的房间或设施，句子通顺就行。

evidence.quote: It has one bedroom, one kitchen and one bathroom.

q7.explanationZh: walk to the mall 说明商场很近，close 表示“近”。

evidence.quote: A flat close to it would be great.
I’m not sure. I will ask the landlord.

q9.explanationZh: A sandwich will be fine for me 表示“三明治对我来说就可以了”。

q10.explanationZh: nearby 放在名词 café 后面作后置定语，表示“附近的”。

evidence.quote: There is one flat for rent nearby.

q11.explanationZh: a perfect match 是“完美的搭配”，前面是 a(n)，perfect 以辅音开头也可。

q12.explanationZh: be allowed to do sth. 是“被允许做某事”。

q13.explanationZh: What can I do for you? 和 How can I help you? 意思基本一样，都是“我能帮你什么吗”。

q14.explanationZh: 前面陈述部分 is 是肯定，反意疑问部分用否定 isn’t，主语 the rent 用 it 代替。

q15.explanationZh: 画线部分是价钱数量，用 How much 提问，再把 is 放在主语 the security deposit 前面。

q16.explanationZh: 主语是 A flat close to the airport（靠近机场的房子），谓语用 would be great：A flat close to the airport would be great.
